prompt_history.carry_closed.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: exactly ONE closed horoscope-book prop for a clean 2D anime/chibi desktop-character asset set.
Input roles: image 1 is the previous CLOSED book EDIT TARGET; preserve its physically coherent book construction, then change its palette, decoration and pose as specified. Image 2 is Aiko's canonical character STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not draw, edit or include the person.
Book identity for this entire V1 set: a medium-thickness, portrait-format hardbound book with deep violet/plum covers (#402958), lighter amethyst/lavender spine accents (#9574B2), subdued warm-gold ornament (#C3A365) and creamy ivory pages. The FRONT cover has one central emblem: a small amethyst four-point star cradled by a muted-gold crescent, inside one fine gold orbit circle. Four simple ornamental gold corner protectors and a clear thin double-gold border give it more mystical decoration than the previous navy draft; keep the large shapes readable at small sprite size. The BACK cover uses the matching border/corners but no large central emblem. The spine has one pair of narrow gold bands near the head and another near the tail, with a small amethyst diamond detail at mid-spine. NO ribbon, bookmark, clasp, lock, title or rune lettering. Any luminous accent stays inside the star/gem material; no outward glow, particles or aura.
Required output state: CARRY_CLOSED. Book is closed and upright in portrait orientation, with its long spine axis almost vertical, tilted only about five degrees. Mild three-quarter front view, just enough from above to see a narrow cream page-block edge at the top/right and a little lower edge. The gold-emblem front cover faces the audience; the left bound spine is visible. Exactly two planar hard covers, one continuous bound spine and one connected contained paper block. Normal medium book thickness. The lower end of the spine is the future conceptual grip point; do not draw a hand or invent an anchor. Keep the whole silhouette and all corners visible, surrounded by clear transparent margin of at least ten percent on the square canvas.
Style: match image 2's crisp slender dark-purple/near-navy anime ink contours, simple controlled cel-shaded planes, calm matte materials and restrained small highlights. The prop should belong with that character. Slight enchanted feeling through purple and the nonverbal astral decoration. No glossy plastic app icon, puffy bevel, 3D-render shine, fabric grain, photoreal texture or painterly wash.
Genuine RGBA transparent background with no background fill, drawn checkerboard, floor, table, cast shadow, backing tile, full character, hands, other objects or additional views. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks or logos. Output this one state as an individual standalone asset, not a sheet or side-by-side comparison.

prompt_history.half_open-02.txt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the fixed violet CARRY_CLOSED book to transform; image 2 is Aiko's STYLE reference only, not a subject to draw. Produce ONE HALF_OPEN state, with the same spine/gold bands, cream pages, plum covers, central crescent and amethyst-star emblem, corner caps and border. No person or hand.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: the book is only cracked open about 45–60 degrees, NOT spread widely for reading. Use a clearly NARROW upright V silhouette. The TOTAL visible width of the entire half-open object should be roughly 65–75 percent of its height. Both portrait-format cover planes are strongly foreshortened, almost edge-on, hinged around exactly one central upright spine. The right front cover still bears the original crescent/star emblem but the emblem's circle is naturally compressed into a narrow ellipse by perspective. The left rear cover is plain except the matching gold edge border. Do not keep two broad almost-frontal cover panels. Keep the same physical book-cover shape and thickness; achieve the narrowness by properly changing the hinge angle and perspective, not by flattening the entire object. This needs to look visibly BETWEEN closed and a broad 100–120-degree reading V.
Camera: audience view of the exterior/spine side, mildly from above. Long bound spine stays nearly upright. Reader is behind the object and sees the inside page faces; we only glimpse upper cream leaf edges. Exactly two connected covers and one coherent bound leaf block meeting at one gutter. Lower spine remains the conceptual future grip, not drawn.
Remove any bookmark, ribbon, tab, strap or little purple paper sticking out of the gutter. There must be NO bookmark anywhere, including behind the pages. Preserve the amethyst/plum/lavender/gold palette, clean fine anime ink, restrained cel-shaded matte planes and intact book construction.
Full isolated book on genuinely transparent RGBA square canvas with ample margin. No shadows, background, ground, glow particles, extra objects, multiple views, text, letters, runes, numbers, watermark or measurements.
